items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Actually I think Joe Fields’s son is more involved now. S – Savant? S-a-v-a-n-t.

ctx.x: No, they didn’t have a big budget. But it was an important label, because one of the things they did is it afforded people who weren’t big stars a chance to record and get their stuff out there. The same – they have another label now, the same people though. Actually I think Joe Fields’s son is more involved now. S – Savant? S-a-v-a-n-t.
Savant. Yeah, it’s the – that’s them. One of the things that musicians like about that label is that they get a pretty much . . .
